title: cystopteris regia var. dickieana
intro: Cystopteris regia var. dickieana, commonly known as the Royal Lady Fern or Dickie's Lady Fern, is a rare, endemic fern species found primarily in Ireland. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory conditions, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Cystopteris regia var. dickieana include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting relaxation. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
